info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Product Eligibility Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Product Eligibility Retrieval API enables financial institutions to assess and retrieve product eligibility details for individual customers. By querying the API with specific customer identifiers, users can determine which banking products are available to their clients based on predefined criteria. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives, credit analysts, and financial advisors who need real-time eligibility data to assist customers effectively. This API streamlines the decision-making process and enhances customer engagement by providing tailored product offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve product eligibility for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the product eligibility details for the customer identified by CUST-100045. It provides information regarding the products the customer is eligible for based on their profile and account status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the product eligibility information for a specific customer identified by `CUST-100045`. It should contain any necessary parameters required for querying the product eligibility.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning eligible products for the specified customer.

GetProductEligibilityForCustomerCUST1000.description: The request body for retrieving product eligibility information under the specified operations. This schema is represented as a string.
